verdict.rationale: Braintrust has its own features that act on many items at once. You can download logs as CSV or JSON or pull them in bulk with `bt sync pull`. Online scoring and Topics also process every trace automatically, and evals run across whole datasets. However, nothing documents a general bulk-operation feature for selecting many items and editing, tagging, deleting or moving them together. Missing for 10: documented multi-select bulk edit/tag/delete/move actions in the UI, API or CLI batch-mutation endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
